status: Terrain controls and actual-world geometry passed; native art and performance NOT accepted yet
geometry: Finite barchan crescents and three-armed star dunes on existing heightfield. Connected transverse ridges remain in high-supply unidirectional sand. No added scenery objects, texture assets, render passes or gameplay tick.
suitability_model: Seasonal wind-vector variation plus a bounded coherent proxy for mountain/valley deflection. This is NOT resolved airflow or a palaeowind reconstruction. Regional susceptibility is interpolated before local deflection is evaluated to avoid coarse sampling aliasing.
constraints: Crescents favor lower sand supply and persistent wind
Stars require strong directional variability and sufficient sand
Explicit asynchronous landmark search, not per-frame search

sources.title: NPS: Dune Types / mountain wind deflection at Great Sand Dunes

known_limits: Raster terrain approximation; no sand transport simulation
Star suitability uses an explicit local-wind proxy
Native appearance and moving FPS still require review
